findings.can_change_hit_test_points_meaning: Permission predicate. Usually blocked for tainted code in combat except assignment tick or same-tick untainted update; no target or focus identity creation.
findings.hit_test_bounds: NamePlateManager documented hit testing is clamped within actual nameplate bounds.
findings.lua_nameplate_click: Native NamePlateUnitFrame explicitly disables mouse; C++ internal hit-test frame performs real detection. XML only has OnLoad and OnEvent, no OnClick target handler.
findings.secure_click_delegation: SECURE_ACTIONS.click only calls delegate:Click after access and forbidden-input checks; it does not perform native C++ spatial hit testing. No evidence of a callable native target delegate exposed by nameplate APIs.
findings.scope_of_conclusion: No new public mechanism found in these 70862 API families; not a proof that no client API exists anywhere.

enemyframes_author_sources.observed: Description begins with author notice that clicking to target is broken after newest Blizzard update; latest file 1.3.0 lists Forever 1.60.1.
Author explains old workaround enlarged native nameplates and mapped click area onto addon bars; placement limitation above mobs.
Author reports newest build appeared to fix old workaround and clicking no longer works.
